cat > /root/acib/scripts/run_fixed_seed2_eval.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

echo "[$(date)] Starting fixed seed2 eval on cuda:0..."
cd /root/acib
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python3 -u scripts/eval_acib.py \
    --checkpoint_dir /root/acib/outputs/acib_v7_seed2 \
    --checkpoint_step 20000 \
    --base_model lerobot/smolvla_libero \
    --suites libero_spatial libero_object libero_goal libero_10 \
    --n_episodes 50 \
    --gpu 0 \
    --out_dir /root/autodl-tmp/v7_eval_fixed_seed2 \
    --seed 42
echo "[$(date)] Fixed seed2 eval complete!"
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/acib/scripts/run_fixed_seed2_eval.sh

tmux new-session -d -s fixed_seed2_eval "bash /root/acib/scripts/run_fixed_seed2_eval.sh 2>&1 | tee /root/autodl-tmp/v7_eval_fixed_seed2.log"
echo "tmux_create=$?"

echo "---TMUX_FINAL---" && tmux ls 2>/dev/null && echo "---GPU_FINAL---" && nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,used_memory --format=csv,noheader && echo "---MONITOR_LOG---" && tail -5 /root/autodl-tmp/v7_eval_fixed_seed2.log 2>/dev/null
